findings.original: by the payment of the weekly value of labour-power
findings.rewrite: by paying the weekly value of labor-power (the value of the means of subsistence needed to keep the worker, and to raise the next generation of workers, able to work)
findings.problem: "value of labor-power" is not a first use in Ch. 10: Marx defines it himself at ch10-p001 (its value is fixed by the working time needed to produce it) and again at ch10-p112, so the §7 explanation here is a redundant addition that the context file's word-match missed.
findings.fix: Delete the parenthetical, leaving "by paying the weekly value of labor-power."

notes_review: The logged calls are sound, especially glossing "manufacturer [manufacturing worker]" in the 18th-century quotations, which prevents a reversal of the argument; only note 1 (adding the value-of-labor-power explanation) is mistaken, because the term was already defined by Marx earlier in the chapter.
summary: Fidelity is very high: the Petty, Postlethwayt and Essay quotations are near-verbatim, the free indirect voices stay attributed, and every date, hour and figure survives. Readability is good; the one fault is a redundant concept explanation in p127.
